facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; no limits on inflows or outflows.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks open accounts in any available foreign currency.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways like Moyasar, HyperPay and Tap weren't researched yet.
facts.L1_registration: Saudi nationals can get a freelance licence online; expatriates need commercial registration.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN from the General Authority for Zakat and Tax (GAZT).
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: No personal income tax, but business income faces zakat (Saudis) or 20% tax (others).
facts.L4_vat_gst: 15% VAT above SAR 375,000 a year; exported services are zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: Personal Data Protection Law, in force since 2023, regulated by SDAIA.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can return unused goods within 7 days.

watch_out.text: Freelance business income isn't simply tax-free; zakat or 20% tax applies.
Expatriates can't use the freelance licence.
